mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Taiwan Parent Company Registration Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait route: notarization by a Taiwan district notary, followed by certification by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) and verification by the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS); this is not Hague Apostille and not consular legalization because Taiwan is not an Apostille contracting state and consular relations do not exist. If the document originates in a Hague Apostille state, the route is notary then Apostille by the competent authority; if it originates in a non-Hague state, the route is notary, foreign ministry authentication, then PRC consular legalization. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of Taiwan Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait route: notarization by a Taiwan district notary, SEF certification, then ARATS verification. For documents from Hague Apostille states, use notary plus Apostille; for non-Hague non-Taiwan states, use notary, foreign ministry authentication, and PRC consular legalization. Hague Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney Appointing the WFOE Incorporation Representative and Local Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Parent Company Board of Directors, notarized by a Taiwan district notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait route: board resolution notarized in Taiwan, certified by SEF, and verified by ARATS; then a certified Chinese translation is filed with the PRC registration authority. Hague Apostille applies only if the board resolution is issued in an Apostille contracting state; otherwise consular legalization applies for non-Hague states. Apostille and consular legalization are separate and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Certified Charter) of Taiwan Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait route: notarization by a Taiwan notary, SEF certification, ARATS verification, followed by certified simplified-Chinese translation. Apostille states use notary plus Apostille; non-Hague states use notary, foreign ministry authentication, and PRC consular legalization. The two authentication regimes are never combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Taiwan Parent Company's Issuing Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait route: bank officer signature and seal notarized by a Taiwan notary, certified by SEF, and verified by ARATS. If the bank branch is located in a Hague Apostille state, the letter must be notarized and apostilled; if in a non-Hague state, notarized, authenticated by the foreign ministry, and legalized by the PRC consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Business Premises Lease and Landowner Consent for Registered Office Use
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial landlord or sub-lessor with certificate of title, notarized in the jurisdiction of the premises
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For premises in mainland China, notarization before a PRC notary and registration with the local real estate authority suffice. For premises outside mainland China, use the applicable cross-strait verification, Hague Apostille, or consular legalization path depending on the origin; never chain Apostille with consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening must cover the Taiwan parent's directors, shareholders holding 25% or more, ultimate beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and all economic sanction targets. The compliance protocol must screen against PBOC domestic high-risk lists, PRC Ministry of Public Security criminal and terrorism lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions and asset-freeze lists, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU and UK consolidated lists, and Taiwan-mainland cross-strait watchlists. Enhanced due diligence applies to any politically exposed person (PEP), including current or former senior foreign officials, domestic officials, their family members and close associates. Screening must be continuous, documented, and refreshed at least every 30 days during formation and before account opening.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration System, integrated with the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE legal name must be in simplified Chinese characters using the standard four-tier structure: administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry or operation description plus organizational form, namely limited liability company (LLC). Names from Taiwan must be transliterated into simplified Chinese; traditional Chinese characters are converted to the national simplified-character standard. An English name is optional for the WFOE and must correspond consistently to the Chinese name for bank account opening and VAT registration purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a name declaration by SAMR, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration to the same-level or higher-level market supervision authority within 60 days of receipt of the written rejection, under the PRC Administrative Reconsideration Law. If the reconsideration decision remains adverse, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit within 15 days from service of the reconsideration decision, or within six months if filing directly with the court. Concurrently, the applicant may re-submit an amended name declaration online, attaching a cover letter demonstrating the requested name's distinctiveness and compliance with the four-tier naming structure, and may request an oral hearing to present evidence.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is rejected by PRC tax authorities and commercial banks for a WFOE engaged in off-price wholesale liquidation of branded overstock apparel. The PRC Company Law requires a fixed domicile supported by a lease or ownership certificate; the tax authority requires physical premises for invoice administration and verification; and banks require a site inspection before corporate account opening. Free-trade-zone administrative addresses are generally not accepted for this industry because the off-price trading model is inventory-intensive and triggers VAT reconciliation and customs review.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced inspection within the first 12 months is 65% for off-price clothing wholesale WFOEs due to VAT invoice and inventory verification. Inspection checklist: original lease and property certificate, office signage, employee presence and labor contracts, inventory warehouse access, purchase and sales contracts, payment and settlement records, bank statements, statutory books and seals, VAT invoices and supporting vouchers, and customs or cross-border logistics documentation for imported overstock. Municipal tax authorities and SAMR may conduct surprise visits if declared turnover appears inconsistent with physical substance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act, Articles 1, 15, 128, 154-156, 172, 192, 203-208, and 387; the Act Governing Relations between the People of Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, Articles 73 and 93; the Regulations Governing Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland People or Enterprises; and, if foreign-national treatment applies, the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Articles 4, 6, 7, and 10, together with the standard implementing regulations of the Ministry of Economic Affairs on company registration and foreign/mainland investment approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan; Department of Commercial Services, MOEA, Taiwan; National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan; Bureau of Foreign Trade, MOEA, Taiwan.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application Form, accompanied by the Articles of Incorporation, foreign/mainland investment approval letter, and certificate of capital verification.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement under the Taiwan Company Act for a limited company. However, the investment approval process requires the full subscribed capital to be remitted into a licensed Taiwan bank account and verified by an authorized foreign exchange bank and a certified public accountant before the company registration filing is accepted. There is no blocked escrow account rule, but the capital must remain on deposit in the company’s capital account for business commencement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD (A TAIWAN COMPANY LIMITED BY SHARES)

At a duly convened meeting of the Board of Directors of CN_WFOE_LTD (the Company), held on ____, 20__, at the Company registered office in Taipei, Taiwan, notice of the meeting having been validly given to all directors in accordance with Article 204 of the Taiwan Company Act, the directors present constituted a quorum and the following resolutions were proposed, seconded, and adopted unanimously by the Board:

RESOLVED, that the authorized share capital of the Company is hereby fixed at the amount set forth in the Articles of Incorporation, divided into ordinary shares with a par value of NT$10 per share; that the entire subscribed share capital has been fully paid in by the sole shareholder by lawful inward remittance; that the paid-in capital has been received and credited to the Company capital deposit account at a licensed bank in Taiwan; and that the officers of the Company be and are hereby authorized to issue certificates representing the shares and to make all necessary filings to evidence the capital subscription.

RESOLVED, that the operating bank account of the Company be established at the bank designated in the registered office; that the General Manager and the Chief Financial Officer, acting jointly, be and are hereby authorized to open such account, execute the bank account application and resolution forms, sign cheques and electronic fund transfer instructions, and provide specimen signature cards to the bank; and that a certified copy of this resolution be delivered to the bank as conclusive authority.

RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby fixed at the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation, in Taipei, Taiwan; that the corporate seal of the Company be adopted; and that the officers be directed to file the registered office notice and seal specimen with the Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs, and other authorities as required by law.

RESOLVED, that the following statutory officers be and are hereby appointed: ____ as Chairman and Director, ____ as General Manager, ____ as Chief Financial Officer, and ____ as the Company Statutory Auditor, each to serve at the pleasure of the Board and until a successor is duly elected; and that the Chairman and General Manager be and are hereby jointly authorized to execute on behalf of the Company all documents, licenses, registrations, leases, employment contracts, tax filings, import and export registrations, warehouse and civil defense permits, and any other instrument reasonably required to commence the lawful business of off-price wholesale liquidation and distribution of branded overstock garments.

RESOLVED, that all officers, agents, and attorneys of the Company be and are hereby authorized and directed to take any and all additional steps, pay all lawful fees, and make all registrations necessary to perfect the incorporation and to carry into effect the spirit and intent of the foregoing resolutions. This resolution is effective immediately and shall remain in full force until rescinded by a subsequent Board resolution.

The meeting was adjourned. Certified to be a true and correct extract of the minutes of the meeting, this ____ day of ____, 20__.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign and Mainland Investment Approval Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, via its online investment application portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute the Application for Investment in Taiwan under the applicable Taiwan investment permitting regime based on the ultimate investor classification. The sole shareholder must submit corporate charter evidence, notarized certificate of incorporation, ultimate beneficial owner identification, capital source declarations, audited financial statements or net worth evidence, a detailed business plan covering off-price garment liquidation, and a declaration confirming that the proposed business is not in a restricted or sensitive sector. Upload all required PDFs to the Investment Commission portal, pay any portal processing fee, and await the formal approval letter. The approval letter will state the permitted investment amount, capital settlement timeline, and binding conditions, including the obligation to remit the subscribed capital into a Taiwan bank account within the valid period. Do not proceed with company registration until the investment approval and capital remittance verification are obtained.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment in Taiwan
Notarized certificates of incorporation and board resolution of the ultimate investor
Ultimate beneficial owner identification and source-of-funds declaration
Business plan and projected profit and loss statement
Declaration of non-restricted and non-sensitive business scope
Power of attorney appointing a local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to incomplete ultimate beneficial owner identification, source of funds, or sector classification, respond within 14 days through the portal with supplementary evidence and a revised business scope declaration. If the application is denied, file a written administrative appeal with the MOEA Appeals Committee within 30 days, or restructure the equity chain and resubmit a new application after curing the stated grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inward Capital Remittance, Bank Verification, and Operating Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Foreign Exchange Bank in Taiwan and the Foreign Exchange Control Department, Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the investment approval letter, cause the shareholder to remit the full subscribed capital in freely convertible foreign currency, preferably USD, EUR, JPY, or HKD, to the designated inbound remittance account at an authorized bank in Taiwan. After the remittance is received, instruct the bank to issue a certified Inward Remittance Settlement Confirmation, then transfer the funds to a newly opened New Taiwan Dollar operating current account of the company. The bank will require a copy of the investment approval letter, the draft Articles of Incorporation, and the company formation resolutions. The bank compliance officer must complete customer due diligence on the ultimate beneficial owner and will issue the account opening certificate and balance confirmation required by the certified public accountant for capital verification. This step must be completed before the company registration filing is submitted.
required_dossiers: Investment approval letter
Inward remittance application form
Draft Articles of Incorporation
Ultimate beneficial owner identification and source-of-wealth statement
Corporate resolution authorizing bank account opening
Power of attorney for the local officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the remittance or account opening due to anti-money-laundering or know-your-customer deficiencies, submit corrected identity and source-of-funds evidence to the bank compliance unit. If the Central Bank or the foreign exchange bank issues a query on the settlement, file an updated foreign exchange declaration within 15 days and, if needed, apply to the Investment Commission for an extension of the capital settlement window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Incorporation Filing at the Taiwan Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, via the e-Company Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After capital verification by a certified public accountant, file the company incorporation application with the Department of Commercial Services. Enclose the incorporation application form, certified investment approval letter, CPA capital verification report, Articles of Incorporation signed by all initial shareholders, registered office lease and landlord consent with a current building usage certificate, list of directors and supervisors, consent forms of statutory officers, and photocopies of identification documents. Pay the prescribed registration fee and submit through the online portal. The registry reviews the lawfulness of the articles, capital subscription, statutory representatives, company name, and office address. Upon approval, the registry issues the Company Registration Certificate and confirms the registered business address and company name. The Unified Business Number, or taxpayer identification number, is then assigned by the tax authority in the next step. Ensure the company name contains the approved limited company designation.
required_dossiers: Company Incorporation Registration Application Form
Certified investment approval letter
CPA capital verification report
Articles of Incorporation
Registered office lease and landlord consent with usage certificate
List of directors and supervisors with written consents
Photocopies of passports and Taiwan ARC or ID documents
Company seal specimen
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry suspends the filing because of company name conflict, missing landlord consent, or defective usage certificate, cure the defect within 10 days by selecting a new name, obtaining the landlord consent, or submitting a professional building usage certificate. If the application is rejected, re-file within 30 days after correction or appeal to the MOEA Administrative Appeals Committee with a written statement of the grounds for reversal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Uniform Business Number, and Import-Export Trade Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan, and Bureau of Foreign Trade, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the taxpayer registration application and entity table with the National Taxation Administration regional office. This includes applying for a Uniform Business Number, filing the business category for wholesale distribution of finished garments, and establishing the taxpayer accounting books. For the off-price wholesale distribution business, also register as an importer and exporter with the Bureau of Foreign Trade to obtain trade registration approval; customs registration can then be filed with the Customs Administration for import and export declarations. Submit the Company Registration Certificate, company seal, responsible person identification, lease contract, and business license applications. The tax authority will issue the tax registration certificate and assign the sole business taxpayer identification. Because failure to register within 15 days after company registration can create penalties under the Tax Collection Act, complete this step immediately after registry approval.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate
Tax Registration Application Form
Responsible person identification and seal card
Business classification form for wholesale apparel liquidation
Invoice purchase certificate application and seal card
Warehouse rental contract and proof of office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried because of an invalid business address or duplicate taxpayer address, provide corrected lease evidence or a new address certificate. If the Bureau of Foreign Trade rejects trade registration because the business scope does not cover import and export, file a company scope alteration with the Department of Commercial Services, then re-submit the trade registration application within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Warehouse Licensing, Fire Safety Inspection, and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Economic Development, Taipei City Government; Fire Department, Taipei City Government; Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Ministry of Labor, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before storing finished garments in the off-price wholesale distribution warehouse, determine whether the premises require a warehouse business registration or public-use building inspection under municipal regulations. Submit floor plans, structural load data, insurance certification, storage classification reflecting textile and flammable finished goods, and HVAC and electrical system certifications. The Fire Department will conduct a physical inspection of fire hydrants, fire extinguishers, fire alarms, emergency lighting, exit signs, and evacuation routes, and will issue the Fire Safety Equipment Inspection Certificate and Civil Defense Use Permit. If the storage operation creates workplace hazards, secure occupational safety approval from the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, including racking inspection, manual handling protocols, and emergency evacuation plans. Post the license at the registered warehouse site and renew the fire safety certificate on the schedule required by the municipality.
required_dossiers: Warehouse occupancy building use permit
Architectural floor plans and structural certification
Fire protection equipment plan and maintenance records
Certificate of fire safety equipment inspection
Occupational safety and health self-inspection form
Business tax registration certificate and Company Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection report identifies deficiencies, remedy the listed defects and schedule a re-inspection within 30 days. If the building lacks the required warehouse use certificate, engage a licensed architect to apply for a change of use with the municipal construction office and suspend storage operations until the certificate is issued and re-inspection is passed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan; Department of Economic Development, Taipei City Government; Taipei City Fire Department.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Wholesale Merchandise Business Registration and Uniform Business Number Certificate, together with the Warehouse Business Premises License and Fire Safety Use Certificate issued by the Taipei City Government and Fire Department.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan, together with the Taipei City Environmental Protection Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable for a pure wholesale and off-price distribution trading operation under the Taiwan Environmental Impact Assessment Act; no full EIA or project-tier assessment is required for ISIC 4641 finished-garment liquidation. If the warehouse exceeds the municipal size threshold or installs stationary generators or boilers, an Environmental Registration under the local air and water permitting regulations may be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No manufacturing process effluents are generated. If the warehouse or office discharges sanitary wastewater to a municipal sewer, the Water Pollution Control Act categorical standards apply: pH 6-9; BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L; COD not exceeding 100 mg/L; suspended solids not exceeding 30 mg/L, or the stricter local sewer acceptance standard. Any standby generator or boiler must comply with the Taiwan Air Pollution Control Act with visible opacity below 10% and fuel sulfur content not exceeding 0.5%. VOC-containing adhesives, if used, must be stored in sealed containers and reported in compliance with EPA VOC reporting requirements. Hazardous waste, if generated from lamps, batteries, or spills, must be stored under segregated containment not exceeding 0.5 metric tons and removed by a licensed hazardous-waste transporter under the Waste Disposal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Equipment Inspection Certificate and Public Use Building Fire Safety Certificate issued by the local Fire Department under the Fire Services Act; Building Public Safety Inspection every two years under the Building Act; structural load and occupancy certificate for the warehouse; and workplace safety and occupational health clearance for racking, manual handling, and emergency evacuation issued by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Ministry of Labor, Taiwan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA) through its unified electronic tax bureau (e-Tax) platform and the local competent tax authorities of the WFOE's registered address.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The CN_WFOE_LTD, formed as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability enterprise under PRC law, obtains its Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) automatically through the market regulation multi-license integration procedure. After issuance of the business license by the Market Regulation Administration, the Uniform Social Credit Code is electronically transmitted to the STA and becomes the statutory TIN for enterprise income tax, VAT, customs, and social insurance. The WFOE must subsequently activate its tax account in the e-Tax portal, register banking and accounting information, and, for export activity, complete the export tax rebate registration (export tax exemption and refund record-filing) with the competent tax authority. A foreign non-resident enterprise with no PRC establishment that derives China-source income obtains a separate non-resident enterprise TIN by filing the non-resident enterprise tax registration information with the competent tax office of the withholding agent or the source income payer; the non-resident enterprise must submit incorporation evidence, a local tax representative authorization if required, and the applicable tax treaty documentation. No physical tax registration certificate is issued; the TIN is confirmed through the e-Tax system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch entity classification election. The WFOE is compulsorily treated as a resident enterprise taxed at the entity level on worldwide income; indirect tax status elections (small-scale versus general VAT taxpayer) are available under the VAT law but do not alter entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) administered under the VAT Law of the People's Republic of China and its implementing regulations, with collection delegated to the State Taxation Administration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary exemption threshold for VAT registration; any operating entity, including a WFOE, must register from establishment date. Under the small-scale taxpayer rules, annual taxable sales of RMB 5,000,000 or less allow simplified VAT treatment, while exceeding RMB 5,000,000 mandates general VAT taxpayer registration with the headline 13% rate on goods sales.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates issuance of VAT invoices through the national Golden Tax digital control infrastructure and the nationwide fully digitalized e-invoice platform. Every VAT special and ordinary invoice must carry a tax control number and be reported in real time to the e-Tax system. General VAT taxpayers use the STA-approved electronic invoice service or application-to-application (API) interfaces for invoice issuance, certification, and verification. Export transactions require zero-rated VAT invoices recorded in the same digital invoice platform, with customs declaration data cross-matched through the tax authority's export rebate database.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The WFOE may claim the 0% export VAT rate for finished garments under ISIC 4641 where the goods are physically exported from the PRC customs territory to Taiwan, are declared under customs export supervision, the seller is a general VAT taxpayer with a valid export tax rebate filing, the sales price is in foreign exchange, and the corresponding foreign currency export proceeds are received by the WFOE in accordance with SAFE trade receipts monitoring. The export must be a genuine offshore sale to a Taiwan-based buyer, supported by the sales contract, commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, and payment evidence; no export zero-rating is available for goods sold within China.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Goods Customs Declaration (Customs Export Declaration) as transmitted by the General Administration of Customs to the STA
Bill of Lading, sea waybill, or air waybill evidencing export from a PRC customs port to a Taiwan port
Commercial invoice and packing list for the off-price apparel shipment
Export sales contract or purchase order

Foreign exchange settlement receipt or bank issuance evidencing repatriation of export proceeds (export collection verification data through SAFE, including the inward remittance record in the bank's foreign exchange system)
VAT zero-rated export invoice (digital tax invoice) issued under the e-Tax e-invoice platform
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to desk review and on-site audit by the STA. The tax authority cross-matches the customs export declaration, the freight log, the e-invoice, and SAFE foreign exchange collection data. If the zero-rating is disallowed due to missing export proceeds, fraudulent documents, circular or unsubstantiated transactions, the refunded VAT is recovered with late payment interest, an administrative fine of 100% to 500% of the fraudulently obtained export tax refund is imposed, the export tax rebate eligibility may be suspended or revoked, and the matter is referred for criminal liability under the Criminal Law if the conduct constitutes fraudulent export tax refund. For fraudulent claims, the recovery period is not time-limited under the PRC tax collection statute.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) together with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the sovereign monetary authority and FX regulator for all mainland China cross-border transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Under China's FX regulatory architecture, current-account transactions are generally convertible and require only documentary authenticity review at the bank, whereas capital-account transactions are subject to strict ex-ante approval, registration, or filing through SAFE administered mechanisms. For a registered wholly foreign-owned enterprise (WFOE), foreign shareholders may convert FDI capital into RMB only after the FDI enterprise has obtained the SAFE Foreign Investment Registration Certificate and opened a designated capital account; proceeds from such conversion are then placed under the Renminbi settlement account with prohibitions on unrestricted use. Profit remittances to offshore shareholders are permitted only after annual statutory audit, corporate income tax payment, and presentation of a profit distribution resolution, audited financial statements, and tax clearance certificates to the settlement bank, which in practice requires a separate SAFE/operating bank check for each remittance. Although China has formally abandoned mandatory export restriction ratios, surrender (repatriation) of trade proceeds remains mandatory for settlement within timeframes aligning with customs and contract terms, with detailed monitoring through SAFE's cross-border receipt and payment platforms. Therefore, despite strict controls, compliance can be achieved by maintaining impeccable documentation for each operating cash flow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No blanket surrender ratio is imposed by SAFE for export proceeds; however, all proceeds must be repatriated to mainland China within the contractually agreed window (normally 90 days from customs declaration but extendable under genuine trade terms) and reported through the goods trade FX monitoring system before repatriation or sale. In practice, banks require the exporter to provide a positive trade background check, customs declaration number, and invoice to support each credit.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account (FX and RMB)
Basic Operational Currency Account and Capital Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility for using offshore digital EMI platforms such as Airwallex, Currencycloud, or Wise for the WFOE's primary account is Low. Mainland Chinese regulators do not grant EMI licences to these entities, and they are legally barred from opening local current or capital accounts in the name of a Chinese-registered company without a licensed bank partner. They may only serve as payment aggregation tools that ultimately clear through domestic banks, and they cannot satisfy SAFE's capital account registration or regulatory reporting obligations. Therefore, the WFOE must maintain its statutory bank accounts with a licensed Chinese commercial bank; EMI rails may be used for ancillary supplier disbursements only after internal compliance review.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under prevailing KYC rules of PBOC and the State Administration for Market Regulation, the WFOE's statutory representative and at least one beneficial owner are normally required to be physically present for the initial account-opening interview at the bank branch. If any signatory or shareholder is located outside the mainland (e.g., Taiwan-based investors), the bank requires a notarised and apostilled/legalised power of attorney, plus certified copies of overseas identification. Some banks allow remote video-identified interviews for non-resident individuals, but this is unilateral bank policy and never replaced the requirement for the mainland-resident statutory legal representative (if any) to attend. In all cases, a physical branch visit by the company's authorised representative is mandatory for collection of USB token and execution codicil.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership behind Taiwan/Hong Kong intermediate holding vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete corporate ownership chart from the Taiwan ultimate shareholder(s) down to the mainland WFOE, with each layer's certificate of incorporation, shareholder register, articles of association, and board resolutions. For any intermediate holding vehicle, provide an audited financial statement or a statement from the Taiwanese CPA confirming the capital contribution path, plus notarised passports/ID cards of all individuals with ≥10% shareholding and bank reference letters from their home jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsubstantiated trade volume and pricing anomalies in off-price garment liquidation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three months of pro-forma and final invoices, purchase orders from end-buyers, warehousing receipts, logistics bills (air/sea waybills), and customs export declaration records (customs column 10) evidencing the goods flow. For first-time transactions, provide a letter of explanation on inventory sourcing and resale pricing mechanics, supported by supplier-side contracts and bank statements showing payment to the upstream vendors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected round-tripping or economic-substance mismatch between the Taiwan entity, mainland WFOE, and offshore settlement accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed operational substance evidence: office lease agreement in mainland, payroll records and social insurance filings for employees, technical/commercial invoices for services rendered, and the board minutes for the distribution of profits and intercompany charges. If material transactions are with Taiwan affiliates, submit an intercompany service agreement, transfer pricing documentation, and annual CPA audit reports for both the Taiwan and mainland entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction flag from cross-border counterparty screening (Taiwan counterparties associated with shell banks)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A bank-passed KYC package for each counterparty including a valid operating licence, tax registration, beneficial ownership declaration, and evidence of physical premises. To neutralise the shell-bank concern, provide a current certificate of good standing for each counterparty, its bank confirmation letter, and a sworn statement that no bearer shares exist in the ownership chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For each FDI capital injection from the Taiwan shareholder, the following protocol must be executed: (1) Complete SAFE's foreign investment (FDI) registration and obtain the Foreign Investment Registration Certificate; (2) Open a dedicated capital account (FDI account) at a licensed bank, designating a purpose code corresponding to 'Capital injection' as per SAFE's standard list; (3) Instruct the remitting bank to use SWIFT MT103 with a purpose code 'CASS' (capital account settlement) or the bank's internal code; (4) Upon receipt, the bank verifies the transfer against the FDI certificate, pre-set remittance details, and the investment contract, then issues a 'bank capital-settlement notice'; (5) For conversion to RMB, the WFOE provides a board resolution specifying the intended use and underlying documents; (6) Post-remittance, the capital verification report must be filed with the State Administration for Market Regulation within 30 days. No debiting of the capital account is permitted without a matching transaction evidence file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For settlements to overseas suppliers or concessionaires, the company must use either SWIFT MT103 (direct wire) for trade invoices under a payment term of open account or advance payment; or commercial letters of credit (L/C) and documentary collections (D/C) for intermediate and large-value consignments. All outbound wiring must be supported by a trade invoice, packing list, customs status, and a signed commercial contract. Banks in mainland China are permitted to clear payments in RMB to Taiwan via the cross-border RMB clearing arrangements (through Bank of China Taipei or similar), or in foreign currency via MT103 through correspondent banks. Outbound remittances for trade payments must be reported under the goods trade category '121010' or relevant sub-code, and large amounts trigger additional scrutiny requiring enhanced due diligence documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore foreign exchange forwards (远期结售汇) for hedging trade exposures
Onshore cross-currency swaps (货币掉期) for capital/re-financing cash flows
Onshore FX options (外汇期权) with real demand backing
Note: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible in mainland China and must not be executed through Chinese banks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting approvals and adoption of statutory financial statements, business report, and profit appropriation or loss-offset proposal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board of directors and shareholders in general meeting; minutes maintained at registered office for inspection by Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Commercial Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year WFOE, no later than June 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting within six months exposes responsible directors to a Company Act fine of NT$12,000 to NT$120,000; failure to maintain approved accounts may trigger a Business Entity Accounting Act penalty of NT$30,000 to NT$300,000; persistent non-compliance qualifies as inactivity and may lead to MOEA administrative strike-off under Company Act Article 10.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-seeking enterprise income tax annual settlement return and ancillary schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau (regional office), Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 through May 31 of the following calendar year for calendar-year taxpayers, including the off-price apparel WFOE, unless an officially announced extension applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a monthly 1% late-filing surcharge on the assessed tax, capped at 10%, plus daily arrears interest at the one-year postal savings fixed-deposit rate; intentional or negligent understatement is subject to a penalty of up to three times the understated tax under Income Tax Act Article 110; repeated failure to file for more than six months may be treated as no business operation and the MOEA may administratively strike off the registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual foreign-investment business operation and shareholding report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC), Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by June 30 following the close of the fiscal year, or within the extended window announced for the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may result in suspension of the investment approval, loss of foreign-investment incentives, a fine of NT$60,000 to NT$200,000 under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, and MOEA strike-off proceedings if the approved business has not been carried on for six consecutive months.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory-register audit certificate and UBO confirmation record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered office corporate secretary; subject to examination by MOEA Commercial Registration Office and tax authority; AML supervisor for UBO matters
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the shareholders' meeting date but no later than June 30; any shareholding transfer or director change must be recorded in the statutory register within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate, missing, or stale statutory registers expose the responsible officer to Company Act fines of NT$12,000 to NT$120,000; failure to update UBO records within 30 days may be treated as an AML violation carrying penalties up to NT$500,000 and director-level criminal liability under the Money Laundering Control Act; chronic failures can be cited as improper governance and trigger MOEA deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent licensed CPA audit is compulsory under Article 29 of the Business Entity Accounting Act and its Enforcement Rules when the WFOE's paid-in capital is NT$30 million or more (approximately USD 1,000,000); there is no separate turnover or headcount audit trigger for a non-public private company. Public issuers under Securities and Exchange Act Article 36 require CPA-audited annual financial statements regardless of size; banking, insurance, securities, and futures enterprises are also mandatorily audited under their respective acts. A private off-price wholesale apparel WFOE with paid-in capital below NT$30 million is not legally required to obtain a certified independent annual audit, but must still prepare statutory financial reports under ROC Business Entity Accounting Standards for tax filing and investment-commission reporting.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: ROC Business Entity Accounting Standards (local GAAP) govern non-public WFOEs, supplemented by the Business Entity Accounting Act; public companies must apply Taiwan-IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission; the WFOE should also maintain tax-basis accounts and IFRS-compatible working papers for consolidated reporting by its Chinese ultimate parent.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not maintain a central public UBO registry for ordinary private WFOEs, but the WFOE must verify and keep current beneficial-ownership and control records under the Money Laundering Control Act; the annual shareholders' meeting is used to confirm UBO data, and any shareholding transfer, director change, or UBO change must be recorded in the statutory register within 30 days and, where the holder is a foreign or mainland Chinese investor, reported to the MOEA Investment Commission for approval or filing before the 30-day clock runs.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' and Board Meetings
Accounting Books and Vouchers Supporting Statutory Financial Statements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 2,500 per annum for registered office, resident agent, and corporate secretarial support in Taiwan
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - USD 18,000 per audit engagement for a private off-price apparel wholesale WFOE

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: PRC standard CIT rate is 25%. Eligible small low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, 300 employees, and RMB 50 million assets are effectively taxed at 5%. High and New Technology Enterprises are entitled to the 15% preferential rate; qualified software and integrated circuit enterprises may enjoy 10% or two-year exemption plus three-year half-rate treatment. R&D expense super deduction is 100% for qualifying expenditures. Loss carryforward may be extended to 10 years for High and New Technology Enterprises and technology-oriented small medium enterprises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: 中华人民共和国企业所得税年度纳税申报表（A类，2017年版）— Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form A, 2017 Revision) and supporting schedules; filed via the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (国家税务总局电子税务局).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement, with quarterly provisional instalments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed within five months after the end of the fiscal year, i.e., no later than May 31 of the following year for a calendar-year taxpayer. Quarterly provisional instalments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the Q4 instalment is integrated into the annual settlement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue from main business, including wholesale liquidation sales of off-price finished garments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for non-resident passive income; the resident WFOE reports active business revenue only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue from other business, such as warehousing, handling, or incidental service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident income from a PRC source without a PE is separately subject to withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of principal operations, including inventory cost of garments sold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident taxpayers do not use Form A for PE unless a deemed PE file is filed separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of other business operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; only resident enterprises file the comprehensive annual Form A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges other than CIT: VAT surcharges, stamp tax, real estate tax, land use tax, and environmental tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident WHT on dividends, interest, and royalties is collected by the withholding agent, not reported here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses, such as freight, commissions for garment liquidation agents, and marketing expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; deductible expenses of a non-resident PE are reported through a separate branch schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General and administrative expenses, including salaries, rent, office costs, professional fees, and amortization.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; allocate properly if the WFOE also acts as a Taiwanese investor's service hub.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses, including interest, bank charges, and exchange differences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; cross-border interest paid to the shareholder is separately subject to 10% withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net gain or loss on disposal of assets, including liquidation or close-out inventory dispositions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; capital gains of a non-resident from equity transfers in a Chinese company are separately taxable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment income, dividends from other PRC resident enterprises, bond interest, and equity-method gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; dividends paid by this WFOE to Taiwan shareholders are not reported in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income, including government grants, debt forgiveness income, and inventory price recoveries.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-residents are not filing Form A unless they carry on business through a PRC establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating expenses, such as donations, losses on disposal of fixed assets, fines, and liquidated damages.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; penalties and tax fines are not deductible in any case.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting profit for the year before tax adjustments (pre-tax book income).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; Form A is a resident enterprise tax-based computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax adjustment increases: non-deductible expenses, centralized excessive entertainment, related-party interest thin capitalisation adjustments, and withholding tax penalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; transfer pricing adjustments may be required through Schedule A105000 for related-party transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax adjustment decreases: tax exemption income, deductible R&D super deduction, accelerated depreciation, and losses on asset impairment reversals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; only resident enterprises enjoy CIT incentives on domestic income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward from prior years and used in the current year (maximum 5 years, or 10 years for qualifying high-tech SMEs).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; loss offsets are limited to a resident taxpayer's own taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; if the WFOE is a resident enterprise, this line is the base for CIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate: 25% standard, 15% HNTE, or effective 5% small low-profit rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident dividends, interest, and royalties are taxed at the statutory 10% WHT under Article 37 CIT Law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT computed for the year at the applicable rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; withholding agent must compute and remit WHT within seven days of the payment date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax reductions and exemptions: regional incentives, environmental protection equipment credits, and integrated circuit benefits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; treaty reductions for non-residents are claimed through the treaty benefit self-assessment process, not Schedule A107040.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable on overseas-source income of this WFOE, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; if the WFOE has foreign PE income, foreign tax credit may be claimed in Form A108010.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit for taxes paid abroad on overseas-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; Taiwan-source taxes on a Taiwan shareholder are creditable in Taiwan, not in this WFOE return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual tax payable for the year after credits and reductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; withholding tax on non-resident payments is not an item in Form A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax already withheld at source on certain income and provisional CIT instalments paid during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident WHT cannot be credited against the WFOE's CIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax due at settlement or overpayment refunded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; any non-resident refund of excess dividend WHT is claimed through the withholding agent or special tax bureau procedure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fine of RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000–10,000 for serious cases, under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law; late payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. Tax evasion through false returns or false invoices triggers a civil penalty of 50%–500% of the evaded tax under Article 63, plus interest and criminal prosecution for tax fraud. Persistent non-payment may lead to asset attachment, bank account freezing, and an exit ban on the legal representative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: 中华人民共和国企业所得税月（季）度预缴纳税申报表（A类）— Quarterly Provisional Corporate Income Tax Return, filed via the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly provisional filing (four times per year at end of Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; Q4 provisional return is replaced by the annual settlement due by May 31.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income for the current quarter, computed using cumulative accounting profit adjusted for estimated book-tax differences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident taxpayers do not file quarterly provisional CIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable for the quarter, at the estimated effective rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; withholding on non-resident distributions is due on the payment date, not quarterly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Less: prior quarters' provisional payments already made.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident with PE income may be required to file branch-level monthly or quarterly estimates.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Underpayment of quarterly instalments is not penalised if the annual return is timely and full. Late quarterly filing is subject to RMB 2,000–10,000 fines and a 0.05% daily late payment surcharge. Intentional concealment of quarterly income to reduce instalments may be recharacterised as tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Under SAT Bulletin 2019 No. 35, a non-resident taxpayer who claims treaty relief must submit a self-assessment information return (非居民纳税人享受协定待遇信息报告表) to the withholding agent and retain the tax residence certificate issued by the treaty counterpart, together with evidence of beneficial ownership and the relevant ownership or holding-period test. The withholding agent may apply the treaty rate if the documentation is complete; otherwise the statutory 10% WHT applies and the non-resident may claim a refund through annual consolidated filing or special collection procedure. For Taiwan, the 2015 Cross-Strait Tax Agreement has not entered into force, so Taiwan-resident shareholders cannot obtain a reduced dividend rate under a bilateral DTA in China. In practice, a 10% dividend WHT is withheld on profit distributions remitted to Taiwan, and Taiwan may grant a unilateral foreign tax credit for taxes paid in mainland China.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory PRC withholding income tax on interest paid to a non-resident enterprise is 10%; royalties are also subject to 10% WHT plus 6% VAT and applicable local surcharges. Under an applicable DTA, interest rates may be reduced to 0%, 5%, 7%, or 10% and royalties to 0%, 3%, 5%, or 10%, subject to beneficial ownership and economic substance. Taiwan has no effective DTA with mainland China for this purpose, so the statutory 10% rate applies to interest and royalty remittances to Taiwan residents.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory if any of the following related-party transaction thresholds for the year is met: tangible asset transfers exceeding RMB 200 million; intangible asset transfers exceeding RMB 100 million; financial asset transfers exceeding RMB 100 million; or other related-party transactions exceeding RMB 40 million. Master File is required if aggregate related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion. Country-by-Country Reporting applies when the ultimate parent's consolidated group revenue in the preceding year exceeds RMB 5.5 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: PRC law does not adopt a separate Economic Substance Regulation regime, but substance-over-form, beneficial ownership, and business purpose doctrines are applied through CIT Law Article 47, the General Anti-Abuse Rule, and SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42. A China WFOE that holds only title to garments while all sales, pricing, inventory risk, and management decisions are performed by a Taiwan affiliate will be disregarded or recharacterised, with related-party income re-allocated to the actual economic actor. For treaty benefit claims, the non-resident recipient must have substantive business activity in its residence jurisdiction; a letter-box Taiwan or offshore conduit will fail the beneficial ownership test and be denied treaty relief. Taiwan's own anti-deferral (CFC) and actual-management location rules complement this analysis.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion: Understated Garment Liquidation Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting cash/off-book sales of off-price garments, using false invoices to inflate cost of goods sold, destroying inventory records, or diverting Taiwanese customers' payments to private or offshore accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63, the tax authority assesses the evaded CIT and imposes a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, plus daily late-payment surcharges of 0.05%. Criminal tax fraud under the PRC Criminal Law may result in imprisonment up to seven years and a fine of up to one times the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives, finance directors, and actual controllers who sign false returns or order invoice fabrication are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of the underpaid tax and penalties; they face travel bans, exit denial, asset seizure, and imprisonment for individuals directly responsible.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Violations on Dividend Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividend profits to Taiwan shareholders without withholding the 10% PRC CIT, or disguising dividends as service fees, consulting fees, or advances to avoid dividend WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A withholding agent that fails to withhold and remit is liable under TCAL Article 69 for a penalty of 50% to 300% of the unwithheld tax. The Taiwan shareholder may also be directly assessed for the underlying CIT. Fabricating service agreements to disguise dividends triggers additional false-invoice penalties under the Invoice Administration Measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve profit distributions or cause the payment of disguised dividends can be held personally for the unremitted withholding tax, with personal bank accounts frozen; serious cases lead to exit bans and criminal liability for intentional tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Mispricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare contemporaneous Local File/Master File after crossing the statutory thresholds, or setting non-arm's length margins for garment sales, management fees, royalties, or cost-sharing arrangements with the Taiwan investor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may adjust taxable income, impose interest at the central bank benchmark loan rate plus five percentage points, and deny deductions or impose a penalty up to 50% of the adjusted tax if false documentation is supplied or the failure is intentional. Repeat or aggravated offenses can attract criminal sanction if the TP arrangement is part of a tax evasion scheme.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and transfer pricing officers who sign false documentation, obstruct audit access, or direct profit-stripping arrangements may face personal sureties, civil liability for the adjusted tax shortfall, travel restrictions, and imprisonment for fraud where intentional concealment is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Artificial WFOE Substance Deficiency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE has no employees, offices, warehouses, purchase orders, sales contracts, logistics functions, or decision-making records in China, yet bills or invoices garments as a conduit for the Taiwan principal to obtain tax benefits, trade rebates, or financial flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The transaction may be recharacterised or disregarded under the GAAR; income is re-allocated to the economic owner; treaty or arrangement benefits are denied; WHT of 10% is imposed on deemed dividends; customs and export registration can be revoked; and AML beneficial ownership reports are subject to PBOC fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and shareholders are personally liable for civil restitution of taxes and penalties, may be prohibited from leaving China until obligations are settled, may be disqualified from corporate management, and can be criminally prosecuted for fraud or money laundering if they knowingly operated a shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Beneficial Ownership Transparency Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify, verify, or update the Taiwanese ultimate beneficial owner of the WFOE, concealing large cash payments for final clearance inventory, or failing to file suspicious transaction reports when related-party transactions show unusual pricing, payment routing, or unexplained third-party settlements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law, institutions face fines up to RMB 4 million and responsible individuals fines of RMB 200,000 to RMB 1 million. Serious violations can result in suspension of business, revocation of licenses, and criminal liability for money laundering under the PRC Criminal Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners who knowingly permit laundering or false BO filings face personal fines, travel bans, confiscation of assets, and imprisonment for up to ten years in aggravated money laundering cases.
